title: DELIBERATELY UNPARSEABLE — a missing comma, the exact defect of 2026-09-10.
$comment: THE COMMA AFTER `title` IS MISSING ON PURPOSE. Do not fix this file. It is the input for GEN_REF_UNRESOLVABLE_INDEX_INCOMPLETE, which had never executed. The repaired form is `carrier.schema.json.repaired`, which the suite copies over this one in the clean run. THE FILENAME AND THE `$id` SHARE NO TOKEN, DELIBERATELY: `carrier` vs `zephyr`. A refusal is allowed to name the URN it could not resolve and must NOT name the file it could not read, and if the two shared a word no assertion could tell those apart.
